{{Quote|Looks like we found your commandos in an engineering subsection. Get down there and help security root them out before they do any real damage. I've got a battle to win.|Rokon|<ref name="Iridonian Darkness" />}}
'''Rokon''' was an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]]-spanning [[Jedi Civil War]], fought between the Republic and [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]] from [[3959 BBY]] to [[3956 BBY]]. A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the war began, Rokon's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] fought in the [[Battle of Iridonia (Jedi Civil War)|Battle of Iridonia]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Iridonia/Legends|same name]].

==Biography==
[[File:Endarconcept.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Rokon's flagship, the ''Champion of Iridonia'', was a ''Hammerhead''-class cruiser (pictured).]]
Rokon served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]],<ref name="Iridonian Darkness" /> a [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]] and the Galactic Republic that began in [[3959 BBY]] and ended in [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the start of the conflict, Rokon's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] was attacked by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces. During the ensuing [[Battle of Iridonia (Jedi Civil War)|battle]], the admiral led his forces from his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Champion of Iridonia]]'', until Sith [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] led by the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Acaadi]] infiltrated the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]].<ref name="Iridonian Darkness" />

An injured Rokon tracked the interlopers from the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] and enlisted the help of a group of Jedi who had been on the planet below. The admiral asked them to head to a section of the ship and deal with the Sith, but Acaadi [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] the ship's systems, thus causing an electrical explosion at the bridge consoles. The explosion [[Death/Legends|killed]] most of the bridge crew and incapacitated Rokon, leaving the defense of the ''Champion'' in the hands of the Republic agents.<ref name="Iridonian Darkness" />

{{RPG|''[[Iridonian Darkness]]''}}
The agents were ultimately able to repel the Sith forces and save the ''Champion of Iridonia''.<ref name="Iridonian Darkness" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rokon appeared in ''[[Iridonian Darkness]]'', a [[Wizards of the Coast]] adventure written for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[Sterling Hershey]]. The adventure was made available for free online from [[Wizards.com]] on [[October 8]], [[2008]]. Although there are alternative paths for the players to take at various junctures in ''Iridonian Darkness'', the meeting with Rokon cannot be avoided nor can the players do anything to prevent his later incapacitation. If the players are unable to save the ''Champion of Iridonia'', they are able to continue their adventure. However, future Sith attacks against Iridonia will be more difficult to repel.<ref name="Iridonian Darkness" />
